1.def: Present Perfect Continuous — o'tmishda boshlanib HOZIRGACHA davom etayotgan (yoki hozirgina to'xtagan) jarayon. Diqqat natijada emas, ishning davomiyligida.
uses: I have been studying since morning.
Hozirgina to'xtagan, izi ko'rinib turgan ish
You're wet. Have you been walking in the rain?
She has been going to the gym lately.
forms: He has been waiting for an hour.
How long + have / has + S + been + V-ing?
How long have you been learning English?
rules: know, like, have (egalik) kabi holat fe'llari Continuous bo'lmaydi.
Son yoki tugagan natija aytilsa — Present Perfect Simple.
I'm waiting for an hour — xato; davomiylik uchun Perfect kerak.
ex: It has been snowing since last night.
Kechadan beri qor yog'yapti.
My eyes hurt. I've been using the computer all day.
Ko'zim og'riyapti. Kun bo'yi kompyuterda o'tirdim.
How long have they been living here?
Ular qachondan beri shu yerda yashashadi?
err: I am working here since May.
I have been working here since May.
I've been knowing him for years.
She has been wrote three emails.

2.def: Present Perfect — qachonligi aytilmagan yoki hozirga ta'siri bor ish. Past Simple — aniq o'tgan vaqtda bo'lib tugagan ish.
uses: I cut it with a knife an hour ago.
forms: Did you hear it on the radio?
rules: When / What time savollari Past Simple bilan.
Vafot etgan odam yoki tugagan davr haqida Past.
Britancha inglizchada just, already, yet bilan Perfect.
ex: Have you met our new boss? Yes, I met her on Monday.
Yangi boshliq bilan tanishdingmi? Ha, dushanba kuni.
I haven't finished yet.
Hali tugatmadim.
Shakespeare wrote many plays.
Shekspir ko'p pyesa yozgan.

3.def: Bu olti so'z Present Perfect'ning «yo'l ko'rsatkichlari». Har birining o'z ma'nosi va gapdagi o'rni bor.
uses: I've lived here for a year, since June.
Have you ever acted? I never have.
forms: S + have / has + V3 + for davr / since nuqta
We've known them for ten years.
S + have / has + just / already + V3
Have you ever lost your passport?
He has never driven a bus.
3.tip: just, already, never, ever — o'rtada; yet — oxirida.
rules: just now bilan Past Simple: I saw him just now.
still inkordan oldin: I still haven't finished.
never bilan not ishlatilmaydi.
ex: I still haven't received my order.
Buyurtmam hali ham kelmadi.
Have you seen her since the wedding?
To'ydan beri uni ko'rdingmi?
They've just announced the results.
Natijalarni hozirgina e'lon qilishdi.
err: I have seen him just now.

4.def: Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi biror paytdan OLDIN bo'lib bo'lgan ish: «o'tmishning o'tmishi».
uses: When we arrived, the film had started.
I was hungry because I hadn't eaten.
It was the first time I had flown.
4.tip: Ikki o'tmish voqeasidan oldinrog'iga had qo'ying.
rules: had barcha shaxslarda bir xil.
Tartib aniq bo'lsa (before, after) Past Simple ham mumkin.
I'd gone = I had gone; I'd go = I would go.
ex: The shop had closed before I got there.
Men yetib borguncha do'kon yopilgan edi.
I couldn't get in because I had forgotten my key.
Kalitni unutganim uchun kirolmadim.
By the time he called, I had gone to bed.
U qo'ng'iroq qilganda men yotib bo'lgan edim.
err: When I arrived, they already left.
When I arrived, they had already left.

5.def: Kelajak uchun uch asosiy shakl: will — shu zahotiy qaror va bashorat; going to — niyat; Present Continuous — vaqti kelishilgan reja.
uses: I'm going to sell my car.
I'm meeting the buyer on Friday.
forms: S + am / is / are + going to + V1
S + am / is / are + V-ing + vaqt
5.tip: Uch savol: hozir o'yladimmi (will)? niyatim bormi (going to)? kelishilganmi (-ing)?
rules: Jadval (poyezd, dars) uchun Present Simple.
when / if dan keyin will yo'q.
I'm going to go o'rniga I'm going ham yetarli.
ex: I've left my wallet. I'll pay you tomorrow.
Hamyonim qolibdi. Ertaga to'layman.
We're getting married in May.
May oyida to'yimiz bo'ladi.
I'm going to learn the guitar this year.
Bu yil gitara o'rganmoqchiman.
err: I will meet her at 5, we agreed.
It will rain, look at those clouds.

6.def: Time clause — kelasi zamonda when, as soon as, before, after, until, by the time dan keyin kelgan qism. Ma'nosi kelajak bo'lsa ham, u yerda will emas, PRESENT ishlatiladi.
uses: I'll call you when I get home.
As soon as she arrives, we'll start.
forms: S + will + V1 + when + Present Simple
I'll text you when I land.
As soon as + Present, S + will + V1
As soon as I know, I'll tell you.
I'll go out after I have finished.
rules: Vaqt gapi boshda kelsa vergul qo'yiladi.
until = …gacha; by the time = …guncha (allaqachon).
Buyruq ham bo'ladi: Call me when you're ready.
ex: We'll start before it gets dark.
Qorong'i tushmasidan boshlaymiz.
Don't move until I tell you.
Aytmagunimcha qimirlama.
By the time you wake up, I'll be gone.
Sen uyg'onguncha men ketgan bo'laman.
err: When I will come, I'll call.
I'll wait until you will finish.

7.def: Zero conditional — doim shunday bo'ladigan qonuniyat. First conditional — kelajakda real bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan shart va uning natijasi.
uses: If you mix red and white, you get pink.
If I have time, I'll visit you.
If you feel ill, go home.
We'll be late unless we hurry.
forms: If it rains, the ground gets wet.
If + Present Simple, S + will + V1
If you ask him, he will help.
If + Present Simple, S + won't + V1
If she's late, we won't wait.
What will + S + V1 + if + Present?
What will you do if you fail?
I won't go unless you come.
7.tip: If qismi — hozirgi zamon, natija qismi — will.
rules: If dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.
If gap boshida bo'lsa vergul qo'yiladi.
will o'rnida can, may, might yoki buyruq ham keladi.
ex: If you press this button, the light comes on.
Bu tugmani bossang, chiroq yonadi.
If the weather is nice, we'll have a picnic.
Havo yaxshi bo'lsa, piknik qilamiz.
Unless you book now, you won't get a seat.
Hozir band qilmasang, joy qolmaydi.
err: If it will rain, I'll stay.
Unless you don't try, you'll fail.

8.def: Second conditional — hozir yoki kelajak haqida XAYOLIY, real bo'lmagan yoki ehtimoli kichik vaziyat: «…sa edi, …gan bo'lardim».
uses: If I had a million dollars, I would travel.
If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If I were you, I would take the job.
forms: If + Past Simple, S + would + V1
If she lived nearer, she would visit more.
If + Past Simple, S + wouldn't + V1
If I were rich, I wouldn't work.
What would + S + V1 + if + Past Simple?
What would you do if you saw a bear?
If I were you, I would + V1
If I were you, I would rest.
8.tip: Shakl o'tgan zamon, ma'no esa hozirgi xayol.
rules: If qismida would yo'q.
I / he / she bilan ham were mumkin (maslahatda odatiy).
could = qila olardim; might = balki qilardim.
ex: If I had a car, I could drive you home.
Mashinam bo'lganida uyingga olib borib qo'yardim.
She would pass if she studied.
O'qiganida imtihondan o'tardi.
I wouldn't do that if I were you.
O'rningda bo'lsam bunday qilmasdim.
err: If I would have money, I would buy it.
If I had money, I would buy it.
If I was you, I will go.
If I were you, I would go.
If he had time, he will help.
If he had time, he would help.

9.def: Third conditional — o'tmishni XAYOLAN o'zgartirish: aslida bunday bo'lmagan va natija ham boshqacha bo'lgan. Ko'pincha afsus yoki tanqidni bildiradi.
uses: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If you had listened, this wouldn't have happened.
If we had left later, we would have missed it.
forms: If + had + V3, S + would have + V3
If she had asked, I would have helped.
If + hadn't + V3, S + wouldn't have + V3
If he hadn't driven fast, he wouldn't have crashed.
What would + S + have + V3 + if + had + V3?
What would you have done if you had lost it?
rules: If qismida would have ishlatilmaydi.
'd = had (If I'd known) yoki would (I'd have gone).
could have = qila olardim; might have = balki.
ex: If I had known, I would have called you.
Bilganimda senga qo'ng'iroq qilardim.
We would have won if he had played.
U o'ynaganida yutardik.
If it hadn't rained, we could have gone out.
Yomg'ir yog'maganida chiqishimiz mumkin edi.
err: If I would have seen you, I'd have stopped.
If I had seen you, I'd have stopped.
If he had worked, he would passed.
If he had worked, he would have passed.

10.def: must, might, could, can't — dalillarga qarab TAXMIN: deyarli aminman (must), balki (might / could), bo'lishi mumkin emas (can't).
uses: He has a big house. He must be rich.
She might be in a meeting.
forms: S + must / might / could / can't + V1
S + must / might / can't + have + V3
rules: Taxminda must ning teskarisi — can't, mustn't emas.
may ham might kabi ishlatiladi.
O'tmish uchun modaldan keyin have + V3.
ex: The lights are on. They must be at home.
Chiroq yoniq. Ular uyda bo'lsa kerak.
I can't find my bag. I might have left it on the bus.
Sumkamni topolmayapman. Avtobusda qoldirgan bo'lishim mumkin.
He can't be hungry. He has just eaten.
U och bo'lishi mumkin emas, hozirgina ovqatlandi.

11.def: Majburiyat va maslahat shkalasi: must / have to — shart; should / ought to — tavsiya; don't have to — shart emas; mustn't — taqiq.
uses: I have to start at eight.
forms: S + don't / doesn't have to + V1
S + had to / didn't have to + V1
11.tip: mustn't = qilma. don't have to = qilmasang ham bo'ladi.
rules: ought to — yagona bu guruhda to bilan keladigan maslahat shakli.
must o'tgan zamonga ega emas: had to.
Savolda ko'proq Do I have to…?
ex: Do we have to wear a uniform?
Forma kiyishimiz shartmi?
You should take a break.
Dam olganing ma'qul.
I didn't have to pay for the ticket.
Chipta uchun to'lashimga hojat bo'lmadi.
err: You mustn't come if you're busy.
You don't have to come if you're busy.

12.def: Majhul nisbat (passive): diqqat ishni qiluvchida emas, ISHNING O'ZIDA yoki unga uchragan narsada. Yasalishi: be + V3.
forms: The book was written by Qodiriy.
12.tip: Aktiv gapdagi to'ldiruvchi passivda ega bo'ladi.
rules: Zamonni be ko'rsatadi, asosiy fe'l doim V3.
by faqat bajaruvchi muhim bo'lsa qo'shiladi.
O'timsiz fe'llar (happen, arrive) passiv bo'lmaydi.
ex: These phones are made in China.
Bu telefonlar Xitoyda ishlab chiqariladi.
The window was broken last night.
Deraza kecha kechqurun sindirildi.
When was the bridge built?
Ko'prik qachon qurilgan?

13.def: Passivning boshqa zamonlari ham bir xil mantiqda: be fe'li kerakli shaklga kiradi, asosiy fe'l esa V3 bo'lib qoladi.
uses: The results will be announced tomorrow.
forms: You will be paid on Friday.
S + can / must / should + be + V3
13.tip: Perfect — been; will va modal — be.
rules: will va modaldan keyin be o'zgarmaydi.
been faqat have / has / had dan keyin.
Inkor: hasn't been, won't be, can't be.
ex: My bike has been repaired.
Velosipedim ta'mirlandi.
A new school will be opened next year.
Kelasi yil yangi maktab ochiladi.
Mobile phones must be switched off.
Telefonlar o'chirilishi shart.

14.def: Reported speech — birovning gapini qo'shtirnoqsiz yetkazish. said yoki told o'tgan zamonda bo'lgani uchun ichki gap zamoni odatda bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi.
uses: He told me he had a car.
forms: He said that he liked it.
She told me she was tired.
She said she had seen it.
14.tip: Vaqt mashinasi: gapni qayta aytganda hamma narsa bir qadam o'tmishga suriladi.
rules: say dan keyin kishi to'g'ridan kelmaydi: said to me yoki told me.
Olmoshlar ham o'zgaradi: «I» → he / she.
Hali ham to'g'ri bo'lgan faktda surmaslik mumkin.
ex: He said he was hungry.
U qorni ochganini aytdi.
She told us she would be late.
U kechikishini aytdi.
They said they had never been there.
Ular u yerda bo'lmaganini aytishdi.
err: He said me the truth was out.
He told me the truth was out.
She told that she was ill.
She said that she was ill.
He said he will come. (o'tgan voqea)

15.def: Ko'chirma savol va buyruq: savol darak tartibiga o'tadi, buyruq esa to + V1 shakliga aylanadi.
uses: She asked if I was married.
The police told us to stop.
forms: S + asked + if / whether + S + V
He asked if I could swim.
Mum told me to tidy my room.
S + told + kim + not to + V1
He told me not to touch it.
15.tip: Ko'chirma savolda do / does / did va so'roq belgisi yo'qoladi.
rules: Zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi.
Iltimos — asked me to; buyruq — told me to.
not to dan oldin to emas: not to go.
ex: She asked me when the shop opened.
U do'kon qachon ochilishini so'radi.
He asked if I had eaten.
U ovqatlanganimni so'radi.
The doctor told him not to smoke.
Shifokor unga chekmaslikni aytdi.
err: He asked where was I going.
He asked where I was going.
She told me not to go.
He asked that I was ready.
He asked if I was ready.

16.def: Defining relative clause QAYSI odam yoki narsa haqida gapirayotganimizni aniqlaydi. Usiz gap tushunarsiz bo'lib qoladi; vergul qo'yilmaydi.
uses: The man who lives next door is a pilot.
I lost the pen that you gave me.
This is the cafe where we met.
I know a girl whose father is an actor.
forms: a phone which takes good photos
the town where I grew up
the boy whose bag was taken
16.tip: Keyin fe'l kelsa who / that shart; keyin ega kelsa tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi.
rules: the film (that) I watched — tushishi mumkin.
the man who called — tushmaydi.
Olmoshdan keyin he / it takrorlanmaydi.
ex: She's the teacher who helped me.
U menga yordam bergan o'qituvchi.
The film we saw was great.
Biz ko'rgan film ajoyib edi.
Is this the street where you live?
Siz yashaydigan ko'cha shumi?
err: The book that I read it
a girl who her name is Lola
a girl whose name is Lola

17.def: Non-defining relative clause allaqachon ma'lum narsa haqida QO'SHIMCHA ma'lumot beradi. U ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi va olib tashlasa ham gap tushunarli.
uses: My brother, who lives in Seoul, is a chef.
Bukhara, which is very old, attracts tourists.
He was late, which annoyed everyone.
forms: Mr Karimov, who teaches maths, is retiring.
The museum, which opened in May, is free.
It rained all week, which spoiled our holiday.
Samarkand, where I was born, is beautiful.
17.tip: Vergullarni qavs deb o'ylang: ichidagini olib tashlasa ham bo'ladi.
rules: that ishlatilmaydi.
Olmosh hech qachon tushmaydi.
what emas, which butun gapga ishora qiladi.
ex: My phone, which I bought last year, is broken.
O'tgan yili olgan telefonim buzildi.
Aziz, whose car is new, gave us a lift.
Mashinasi yangi bo'lgan Aziz bizni olib bordi.
She passed the exam, which made her parents proud.
U imtihondan o'tdi, bu ota-onasini faxrlantirdi.
err: London, that is huge, is expensive.
London, which is huge, is expensive.
My mother who is 50 works here.
My mother, who is 50, works here.
He didn't call, what upset me.
He didn't call, which upset me.

18.def: Gerund (-ing) va infinitive (to + V1) — ikkinchi fe'lning ikki shakli. Qaysi biri kelishini birinchi fe'l belgilaydi; ba'zi fe'llarda ma'no ham o'zgaradi.
uses: He stopped talking. He stopped to talk.
I remember meeting her. Remember to meet her.
forms: enjoy / finish / avoid / mind / suggest / keep / practise + V-ing
want / hope / decide / plan / afford / manage / refuse + to + V1
18.tip: stop doing — bas qildi. stop to do — boshqa ish uchun to'xtadi.
rules: Gap boshida ish nomi -ing bo'ladi: Swimming is healthy.
Predlogdan keyin doim -ing.
Inkor: not going, not to go.
ex: I can't afford to buy it.
Uni sotib olishga qurbim yetmaydi.
Do you mind closing the door?
Eshikni yopib yuborsangiz maylimi?
Remember to take your keys.
Kalitni olishni unutma.
err: He left without to say anything.

19.def: used to — ilgari shunday edi (hozir yo'q). be used to — ko'nikkanman. get used to — ko'nikyapman. Uchalasi o'xshash, ma'nosi har xil.
uses: You'll get used to the food.
forms: We used to live in a village.
Did you use to play chess?
S + am / is / are used to + V-ing / ot
She is used to working late.
S + get used to + V-ing / ot
I'm getting used to driving here.
19.tip: be / get bo'lsa — keyin -ing. Faqat used to — keyin V1.
rules: be used to va get used to dagi to — predlog.
used to faqat o'tmish uchun.
was used to — o'tmishda ko'nikkan edim.
ex: He used to be very thin.
U ilgari juda ozg'in edi.
I'm not used to getting up so early.
Bunchalik erta turishga ko'nikmaganman.
How did you get used to the noise?
Shovqinga qanday ko'nikding?
err: I'm used to get up early.
I'm used to getting up early.
I use to walk every day. (hozir)

20.def: Question tag — gap oxiriga qo'shiladigan qisqa savol: «shunday emasmi?». Gap darak bo'lsa tag inkor, gap inkor bo'lsa tag darak bo'ladi.
uses: You didn't lock the door, did you?
forms: darak gap, yordamchi fe'l + n't + olmosh?
I am → aren't I? ; Let's → shall we? ; buyruq → will you?
20.tip: Ko'zgu qoidasi: plus gap — minus tag, minus gap — plus tag.
rules: Tagda ism emas, olmosh ishlatiladi.
Pasayuvchi ohang — tasdiq kutish; ko'tariluvchi — haqiqiy savol.
nobody, everyone → they: Nobody called, did they?
ex: You're from Tashkent, aren't you?
Toshkentdansiz, shundaymi?
He hasn't left, has he?
U ketmagan-a?
We met last year, didn't we?
O'tgan yili uchrashgandik, to'g'rimi?

21.def: Indirect question — savolni muloyim kirish iborasi bilan berish. Kirish qismidan keyin savol tartibi emas, darak tartibi keladi.
uses: Can you tell me where the station is?
I'd like to know when the course starts.
I wonder if she remembers me.
forms: Can you tell me + wh-so'z + S + V?
Can you tell me how much it costs?
Do you know + if / whether + S + V?
Do you know if the bank is open?
I wonder / I'd like to know + wh-so'z + S + V
21.tip: Kirish iborasi savol — ichi esa oddiy darak gap.
rules: do / does / did ichki qismda yo'qoladi.
I wonder bilan boshlangan gapga so'roq belgisi qo'yilmaydi.
to be egadan keyin: where it is.
ex: Could you tell me what time you close?
Soat nechada yopilishingizni aytsangiz?
Do you remember where we parked?
Mashinani qayerga qo'yganimiz esingdami?
I'd like to know whether breakfast is included.
Nonushta kiritilganini bilmoqchi edim.
err: Can you tell me where is it?
Can you tell me where it is?
Do you know when does it start?
Do you know when it starts?
I wonder is he at home.
I wonder if he is at home.

22.def: Miqdor so'zlari otning turiga qarab tanlanadi. a few / a little — «oz, lekin bor»; few / little — «deyarli yo'q»; too — me'yordan ortiq; enough — yetarli.
uses: I have a few friends and a little money.
forms: many / a few / few / too many + ko'plik ot
much / a little / little / too much + ot
22.tip: a harfi — umid: a few = bir nechta bor; few = juda kam.
rules: a few + ko'plik, a little + sanalmaydigan.
too salbiy ma'no beradi; ijobiyda very.
much va many darak gapda ko'pincha a lot of bilan almashtiriladi.
ex: Can I have a little milk?
Ozgina sut bersangiz.
She has too much work this week.
Bu hafta uning ishi haddan ko'p.
He isn't old enough to vote.
U ovoz berish yoshiga yetmagan.

23.def: Qiyoslashning to'liq to'plami: tenglik (as … as), o'zaro bog'liq o'zgarish (the more … the more), eng yuqori daraja va kamlik (less / fewer).
uses: This is as good as that.
The more you read, the more you learn.
It's the busiest street in town.
We need less noise and fewer cars.
forms: the + sifat-est / the most + sifat (+ in / of)
the most famous in the world
rules: the … the tuzilmasida ikkala qismda ham the.
much, far qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi.
Qisqa sifat oldidan more qo'yilmaydi.
ex: The older I get, the less I worry.
Yoshim o'tgani sari kamroq tashvishlanaman.
It's by far the best option.
Bu — shubhasiz eng yaxshi variant.
There are fewer students this year.
Bu yil talabalar kamroq.
err: More you practise, better you get.
The more you practise, the better you get.

24.def: Linkers fikrlarni mantiqan bog'laydi: qarama-qarshilik, sabab, maqsad. Har birining grammatik qolipi bor — keyin gap keladimi yoki ot / -ing.
uses: Although it was late, we kept working.
We stayed in because of the rain.
I got up early to catch the bus.
forms: Although he's rich, he lives simply.
despite / in spite of / because of + ot / V-ing
The test was hard. However, I passed.
He saves in order to buy a flat.
so that + S + can / could + V1
Speak up so that everyone can hear.
rules: despite of — xato.
however dan keyin vergul qo'yiladi.
although bilan but birga ishlatilmaydi.
ex: In spite of the price, I bought it.
Narxiga qaramay sotib oldim.
She was tired; however, she didn't stop.
U charchagan edi, biroq to'xtamadi.
I wrote it down so that I wouldn't forget.
Unutmaslik uchun yozib qo'ydim.
err: Although he was ill, but he came.
Although he was ill, he came.
I went there for buy bread.
I went there to buy bread.
